_about: Public-domain John of the Cross (1542-1591, Carmelite) in English for the Word Hoard: David Lewis's Complete Works (1864, two volumes), his translation as revised by Benedict Zimmerman (the Ascent, Dark Night, Spiritual Canticle and Living Flame, 1906-1912), and Gabriela Cunninghame Graham's independent Dark Night of the Soul (1905), all from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

john-cross-complete-works-1: The Complete Works of Saint John of the Cross, vol. I: the Ascent of Mount Carmel and the Dark Night, tr. David Lewis (London: Longman, Green, 1864)
john-cross-complete-works-2: The Complete Works of Saint John of the Cross, vol. II: the Spiritual Canticle, the Living Flame and other works, tr. David Lewis (London: Longman, Green, 1864)
john-cross-dark-night-graham: The Dark Night of the Soul, done into English by Gabriela Cunninghame Graham (London: John M. Watkins, 1905)
john-cross-ascent-1906: The Ascent of Mount Carmel, tr. David Lewis, revised by Benedict Zimmerman (London: Thomas Baker, MDCCCCVI)
john-cross-dark-night-1908: The Dark Night of the Soul, tr. David Lewis, revised by Benedict Zimmerman (London: Thomas Baker, MCMVIII)
john-cross-canticle-1909: A Spiritual Canticle of the Soul and the Bridegroom Christ, tr. David Lewis, revised by Benedict Zimmerman (London: Thomas Baker, MCMIX)
john-cross-living-flame-1912: The Living Flame of Love, with his Letters, Poems and Minor Writings, tr. David Lewis (London: Thomas Baker, MCMXII)

_alternates.john-cross-copies: Other 1864 copies; Lewis's second edition of the Dark Night, Canticle and Living Flame (Baker, 1891; darknightofsouls00sain); further 1906-1922 printings
_alternates.john-cross-ccel-canticle: CCEL john_cross/canticle: the 1909 Lewis text modernised by its digitiser in 1995, no print source

_excluded.john-cross-ccel-peers: CCEL john_cross/ascent and dark_night: Peers's translation (1950s)
_excluded.john-cross-late: printings of 1934 and later; French editions
